resources.string: Turn any message into a long, winding ramble. Select text in any app and tap Ramble, or try it here.

1. In any app, select the text you want rambled.
2. In the menu that pops up, tap ⋮ or More, then Ramble.
3. Tap Replace to swap your text for the ramble, or Copy.

Replace works in boxes you're typing in. For text you can't edit, like someone else's message, use Copy.
Without a server, Rambler uses its built-in phrase book. For AI rambles, deploy the Rambler server (the README in the repo walks through it) and enter its address and app key here.
Use AI when the server is set up
The address must start with https://
